clips.title: The story
paras: Magistrate Solomon is the chief magistrate of Lakeshire, presiding over local affairs from the town hall. Besieged by Blackrock orcs and relentless gnoll clans, he spends his days frantically pleading for military aid from an indifferent and distracted Stormwind.

Magistrate Solomon governs Lakeshire during the darkest hour in its recent history. The tranquil lakeside settlement is surrounded by hostility: Redridge and Shadowhide gnolls prowl the surrounding hills, while Blackrock orcs descend from the north in organized warbands. Solomon works alongside Marshal Marris to maintain civil order and muster a defense, but Lakeshire's local guards and militia are stretched to their absolute breaking point.

Desperate to secure reinforcements, Solomon has dispatched messengers across the kingdom—pleading for aid from Westfall, Darkshire, and the capital of Stormwind itself. His petitions have yielded bitter disappointment. Westfall struggles under the grip of the Defias Brotherhood, Duskwood is consumed by its own creeping terrors, and Stormwind City refuses to deploy troops to the eastern frontier, leaving Lakeshire entirely to its own devices.
